newsitem.title: USA: American Freightways to cut 1,000 jobs.
newsitem.headline: American Freightways to cut 1,000 jobs.

text.p: American Freightways Corp said Tuesday about 1,000 employees will be cut when it completes a system-wide restructuring of its line haul and terminal operations this month.

The company said that the reduction in its workforce is not associated with business levels, which remain on target to reach its upwardly revised goal of $720,000,000 in revenue during 1996, an increase of 26 percent over its 1995 revenue level.
American Freightways said that the restructuring will provide for most of its pickup and delivery drivers to work on the dock a portion of their workshifts.
The company said that about 50 percent of the line haul changes have been completed to date.
American Freightways Corp is a scheduled, for-hire carrier of less-than-truckload shipments of general commodities.
